create_logger_for_training: create a Logger instance to write timestamped logs to a file and optionally log to wandb
log_message_with_logger: use the Logger log method to write a timestamped string to both the log file and stdout
set_random_seed_reproducibility: call set_random_seed to set a fixed seed across random, numpy, torch, and CUDA
synchronize_metrics_distributed: use metric_synchronize_between_processes to average metric values across all distributed training processes
create_distributed_progress_bar: use tqdm_distributed to show a tqdm progress bar only on the main process during distributed training
